an5.54:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu jiṇṇo hoti jarāya abhibhūto.
an5.54:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vyādhito hoti vyādhinā abhibhūto.
an5.54:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ na sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
an5.54:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhayaṃ hoti aṭavīsaṅkopo cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti.
an5.54:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave saṅgho bhinno hoti.
an5.54:5.2: saṅghe kho pana bhikkhave bhinne aññamaññaṃ akkosā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ paribhāsā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ parikkhepā ca honti, aññamaññaṃ pariccajanā ca honti.
an5.54:5.3: tattha appasannā ceva nappasīdanti. pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattaṃ hoti.
an5.54:5.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañca asamayā padhānāyā’ti.
an5.54:6.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu daharo hoti. yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā
an5.54:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya.
an5.54:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave subhikkhaṃ hoti susassaṃ sulabhapiṇḍaṃ, sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
an5.54:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave manussā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti.
an5.54:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave saṅgho samaggo sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharati.
an5.54:10.2: saṅghe kho pana bhikkhave samagge na ceva aññamaññaṃ akkosā honti. na ca aññamaññaṃ paribhāsā honti. na ca aññamaññaṃ parikkhepā honti. na ca aññamaññaṃ pariccajanā honti.
an5.54:10.3: tattha appasannā ceva pasīdanti. pasannānañca bhiyyobhāvo hoti.
an5.54:10.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañca samayā padhānāyā’ti.
